encoding_variations: completion_status and borrower_election_or_waiver may both appear ('completed' vs 'borrower waived counseling'); keep both so a reviewer can distinguish a completed session from a waiver.
Counseling date vs certificate issue date vs signature date can all differ; counseling_date is the substantive event, the signature date the consent event — keep them separate.

open_questions.q: Certificate vs authorization — this catalog conflates the counseling authorization and the counseling completion certificate.
options: keep both completion_status and counseling_certificate_number typed
open_questions.recommendation: keep both completion_status and counseling_certificate_number typed so either variant is captured; flag to the domain expert whether these should be two document types

open_questions.q: Enum degradation — counseling_type, completion_status, delivery_method, and borrower_election_or_waiver all degrade to strings.
open_questions.recommendation: accept and rely on snippets; add a coercer only if a future FHA/HECM rule needs a typed status

notes: No rules read this document today, so there is no rule floor; this is a HUD counseling consent/completion artifact (common for FHA, HECM, and first-time-homebuyer programs).
Prompt hint (doc-level): the reviewer checks approved agency (HUD ID present), completion status, and that it predates the relevant milestone.
Prompt hint (doc-level): distinguish from the general borrower authorization (055): this one is specifically about counseling and sharing loan info with the counseling agency.

PII: loan_number is a confidential identifier flagged for review. hud_agency_id and counseling_certificate_number are organizational identifiers, not personal PII; no masking needed. No SSN/account field in this catalog.

Ambiguity: loan_number's why is 'linkage' (classified identity); counseling_type's why is 'identity/processor' (classified identity, first listed); borrower_signature_date's why is 'execution' — not one of the five reason classes; classified as processor.
